_comment: Allowed public API breaks against the last release (v0.4.1). Each entry names the spec section 2 B-item whose migration note documents it. b_item null = a gap: a break with no migration note. The check fails on gaps by default; `api_breaks.py --allow-gaps` lists them without failing (informational only, never in CI).

entries.note: tenant_id now defaults to a sentinel so that omitting it can emit the B19 FutureWarning (strict_tenancy flips to True in 0.6). Behaviour when omitted is unchanged in 0.5.
tenant_id defaults to UNSCOPED; None now means untenanted only.
timeout= defaults to the TIMEOUT_UNSET sentinel: provider deadlines are call_timeout / connect settings (B18, spec section 5.2), and passing timeout= is deprecated with a DeprecationWarning.
save_run_event no longer takes sequence_index; it allocates and returns it.
event_sequencer removed together with EventSequencer. PersistenceRecorder is internal in practice, but griffe sees it as public.

Static-analysis artifact: the attributes still exist at runtime but are now set in ProviderError._set_provider_fields, so griffe no longer sees them. ContextLengthExceededError now subclasses ProviderError (B10). Fix in src: declare the attributes as class-level annotations.
make_read_router and dendrux.http are removed (B20). docs/upgrading-to-0.5.0.mdx maps each old endpoint to a RunStore method.
The embedded dashboard and the `dendrux dashboard` command are removed (B20); build your own views on RunStore.
cli.traces.app, the internal Typer sub-app, is removed (B20). `dendrux traces RUN_ID` is a plain command now and still works; options may follow the run id.
